question: By how much should the fire-pit be enlarged on all sides in this case?
premises: The fire-pit is to be increased on all sides.
The increase is made by the previously mentioned measure.
The resulting size of that fire-pit is two hastas.
inference: Increasing the fire-pit on all sides by that measure makes it two hastas in size.
plain_english: One should increase that fire-pit on all sides by that measure, so that it becomes two hastas.
